This large iron sledgehammer was originally used for mining, but it works reasonably well as a weapon too.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 12 |durability = 40 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Iron Sledgehammer}} Iron Sledgehammers are [[Goron]]-made [[Hammer]]s that can be found in all the major populated settlements of [[Hyrule Kingdom]].{{Fact}} They are reasonably durable, and good for breaking open [[Ore Deposit]]s. Despite being crafted by Goron blacksmiths, they appear to be favored most by [[Hylian]]s, such as [[Bolson]], [[Karson]], and [[Hudson]]. Iron Sledgehammers are two-handed Weapons, meaning they can not be used in conjunction with a Shield. They were originally used for mining, but the Gorons of the [[Southern Mine]] have found more use in [[Pickaxe]]s.{{Fact}} Befitting their original purpose as a mining tool, the Iron Sledgehammer has a hidden property that increases its damage dealt by four times when used against the Ore Deposit atop a [[Stone Talus]]. It is also capable of immediately destroying [[Stone Pebblit]]s. Iron Sledgehammers have a metal head and a wooden pole, but they are considered metal [[Weapon]]s. This means they will not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]] can move them, and they will attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]].
